proves.claim: clause 1: a host PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH reaches the job environment unchanged.

drive.machine-home.playwright-path-passe.why: A pulled job's HOME is empty, so without this browser tests could not find the host's installed Playwright browsers (GitHub #33).

proves.claim: clause 2: with no host value the job gets the host default browser cache folder when it exists.

drive.machine-home.playwright-default-ca.why: A pulled job's HOME is empty, so without this browser tests could not find the host's installed Playwright browsers (GitHub #33).
